# Cliperus

> Cliperus is a creator rewards platform where content creators earn real money for views on TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram — through clipping campaigns, an affiliate program, and a creator marketplace.

Cliperus connects brands with creators. Creators discover paid campaigns, submit clips of their work, and get paid per 1,000 verified views. A marketplace lets creators buy and sell digital products (courses, templates, communities, coaching), and an affiliate program rewards referrals.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform, featured campaigns, and how creators earn.
- [Campaigns](/campaigns): Browse brand-sponsored clipping campaigns open for submissions.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Discover courses, templates, memberships, and digital products from creators.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Public showcase of creator submissions and top-performing content.
- [Affiliate](/affiliate): Referral program details, commission structure, and share links.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans, fees, and payout terms.
- [About](/about): Company mission and story.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles at Cliperus.
- [Contact](/contact): Support and business contact channels.
- [Support](/support): Help centre and frequently asked questions.
